high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "cait.knight," taken one day prior to the screenshot being captured. The photo features two women posing together against a backdrop of a city skyline at dusk or night, with illuminated buildings and a gradient sky transitioning from light blue to darker shades. The woman on the left has long, wavy hair and is wearing a sleeveless top with a deep neckline. She is blowing a kiss towards the camera with her eyes closed, and she has a bracelet on her wrist.
